name: ableton-control
description: Ableton Live control surface for the Elgato Stream Deck + on macOS: track, mixer, transport and zoom, with live feedback.

scripts.check:python: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c "import ast,pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text(), str(f)) for f in pathlib.Path('ableton').rglob('*.py')]"
scripts.pack: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run profile && npm run plugin
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && npm run test:python
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run pack
